purpose: Single inspectable inventory of primary public sources for Tri-State evidence. Retrieval time is not product vintage.

sources.title: Water Data APIs v1
sources.license: US government public information (see USGS terms)
sources.notes: Prefer over legacy WaterServices before planned early-2027 retirement

sources.title: National Water Prediction Service
sources.vertical_datum: GAGE_DATUM for stage; product tables for zeros
sources.notes: Forecast layer separate from USGS observed; never silent substitute

sources.title: Ohio River at Mount Vernon (MTVI3)
sources.notes: Do not apply zero to other station IDs

sources.title: 3DEP / LidarExplorer
sources.vertical_datum: typically NAVD88 for CONUS DEMs — confirm product
sources.notes: Reconcile terrain/building coverage; do not invent heights

sources.title: NFHL / MSC FIRM FIS
sources.notes: Official map product discovery entry point. Retrieve and verify the exact effective panel and FIS separately.

sources.title: National Flood Hazard Layer MapServer
sources.notes: Service endpoint. Pin the layer, product vintage and query or export receipt before using feature bytes.

sources.title: GEOID18
sources.notes: Record model, coverage, uncertainty on every transform

sources.title: VDatum
sources.notes: Do not merely label a number NAVD88 without model evidence

sources.title: Indiana geospatial / parcels / imagery services
sources.notes: Posey County cadastre and state layers

sources.title: HEC-RAS HDF5 results (imported)
sources.notes: Read-only import; TSM does not validate the hydraulic model

sources.title: Illinois Height Modernization Program lidar and elevation catalog
sources.layer_or_collection: County and statewide lidar and elevation products
sources.notes: Confirm county coverage, acquisition epoch, source CRS, vertical datum and units on the exact product.

sources.title: KyFromAbove Catalog Explorer
sources.layer_or_collection: KyFromAbove lidar, DEM and imagery collections
sources.notes: Pin the STAC collection, item and asset for the area of interest and verify source CRS, vertical datum and units.
